description: Get the latest 4 weeks of a weekly Rio Grande Valley series for free: permits-weekly (building permits by city), cost-basket-weekly (building-input prices), absorption (housing supply), labor-ranges (labor and financing conditions) or calls (graded forecasts). Each row carries its week, as_of date and status. The full history is a paid endpoint; how_to_pay with series-<name> gives its URL and price.
